Definition: Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kanah = "reed"; 1) a stream flowing into the Mediterranean Sea that marked the boundary between Ephraim on the south and Manasseh on the north; 2) a town marking the boundary of Asher
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
